note: The per-video annotation file is open; the videos need the signed research-only agreement, so there is no media. One example is one CSV row: video name (anomaly type + number), scenario, total frames, and the first/last frame of the anomaly. No frame rate is given, so the timeline is left empty rather than guessing seconds.
